**Best move:** Qxa8+

**Main line:** Qxa8+ Qd8 Qxd8+ Kh7 (or any king move) and White is up a full rook.

**Motif:** hangingPiece (the undefended rook on a8 is the weakness)

**Coaching note (80 words):**
Black's rook on a8 is undefended—always scan for loose enemy pieces first. Your queen on f3 can capture it with check. When you win material with check, the opponent can't immediately recapture because they must get out of check. Even if Black tries Qd8 to attack your queen back, you trade queens while still winning the rook. The lesson: undefended pieces near the back rank are vulnerable to queen checks from the center of the board.
